fields.userId: string - reference to authenticated user in users.json
fields.phone: string - farmer's phone number (11 digits, starts with 01)
fields.nationalId: string - farmer's national ID (13 digits for NID, or passport)

WIZARDPROGRESS.description: Tracks wizard completion state for resume functionality

fields.farmerId: UUID - reference to FARMER.id (or temp ID if farmer not created yet)
fields.completedSteps: array<number> - list of completed step numbers
fields.stepData: object - { 1: {...}, 2: {...}, ... } - saved form data per step
fields.resumeToken: string - unique token for session resumption (optional, for security)
fields.completedAt: number - timestamp when wizard completed (null if not complete)
fields.expiresAt: number - timestamp when wizard session expires (24 hours)

notes.storage: All tables stored in separate JSON files under data/ directory
